title: Caravelas Stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as Caravelas stone, sourced from Brazil. It has a cream-colored base with streaks of dark gray to charcoal and mottled amber patterns. The stone measures approximately 115 to 122 inches in length, 65 to 75 inches in width, and is available in thicknesses of either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches. It is composed predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, classified geologically as granite. The sides of the stone are cut or sawn, and the top surface is polished. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and office furniture surfaces.

title: Zurich stone
facts: The article is a natural stone material known as Zurich stone, sourced from Brazil. It appears ivory-colored with brown mottling and streaks. The stone measures approximately 300 centimeters wide by 200 centimeters long and is available in thicknesses of either 2 or 3 centimeters. It is composed predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, classified geologically as granite. The top and side surfaces of the stone are polished, and the edges are beveled. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use in both indoor and outdoor applications, including countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring.

title: Bale Handler and Bale Feeder
facts: The Soft Hands Bale Handler, model LX200, is a hydraulically powered attachment designed to grip and handle both round and square bales. It features a heavy-duty steel frame with gripping ‘hands’ and is intended for use with tractors, front-end loaders, or telehandlers using an appropriate mounting bracket. Power comes from the hydraulic system of the host machine. The Chainless Trailed Series Bale Feeder, model TX205, is a single-axle towable machine used to lift, unroll, and spread material from bales. It includes rear-facing bale forks, a pivoting cradle-like platform, and a rotor with blades. The forks place a bale onto the platform, which then presses it against the rotating rotor to unroll the material into a windrow. This feeder is powered by the hydraulic system of the towing tractor.

title: Wheeled Excavator Carrier
facts: The item is a wheeled excavator carrier, series designation Sleipner E50, designed for moving heavy-duty tracked excavators in mining or quarry environments. It attaches to the rear tracks of an excavator, enabling the excavator to secure itself in the bed of an articulated dump truck (ADT) for transport. The carrier allows the ADT to tow the excavator at speeds up to 15 kilometers per hour, reducing travel time and extending track life. Each carrier includes a steel track shoe and is supported by two rubber tires. The shoe's frame is shaped like a scoop with a flat bottom and vertical triangular sides, joined by a horizontal steel bar. The carrier is composed of 85% steel and 15% rubber parts.

title: Actisweep Industrial Push Broom with Bristle Segments
facts: This is a heavy-duty, non-motorized mechanical sweeping device meant to attach to a motorized host vehicle like a forklift, agricultural tractor, or telehandler for tough industrial cleaning inside and outside buildings. It has a rectangular steel frame, a brush system with many rows of high-density polypropylene fiber bristles, and a heavy mechanical interface made of galvanized steel that bolts or fastens to the top of the steel frame and can be swapped for different host vehicles. The underside of the steel frame has factory-welded tracking rails to hold, secure, and allow swapping of the bristle rows. The broom works by the friction and forward motion from the host vehicle that it is attached to. It comes in three models with different numbers of bristle rows and bristle lengths. The steel frame is made in Turkey and the bristles are made in the European Union. The push broom is imported unassembled but grouped in one complete kit ready for the end user to bolt together.

title: NV2C-28V-SF Navigator Compass
facts: The NV2C-28V-SF is a precision standby instrument designed for light aircraft, gliders, and microlights. It features an integrated four-magnet correction system to minimize magnetic interference from the vehicle's electrical and mechanical systems. The compass uses a liquid-damped card housed in silicone-based fluid to prevent leaks and reduce lead/lag errors, with metal expansion bellows that compensate for high-altitude pressure changes. An adjustable bracket allows mounting on the glareshield, windshield center post, or canopy, providing a 140-degree heading view. The device determines direction using an internal magnetic mechanism and includes low-voltage electrical connectors solely for LED dial illumination.

title: The Mamba Power Cable
facts: The product is a high-fidelity power cable designed to connect audio and video components to standard domestic power outlets. It consists of three separate lengths of 3-conductor electrical cable. Each cable length is sheathed in fiberglass fabric. One end of each cable features a heavy-duty C15 or C19 connector, while the opposite end has a standard 3-pin plug. The connectors are insulated, hand-braided for durability, and selected based on the customer's specific requirements.

title: Steel Cord Conveyor Belt
facts: This product is steel cord reinforced vulcanized rubber belting. It contains a vulcanized rubber top cover, a layer of longitudinal steel cords for reinforcement, skim rubber positioned between the cords, and a vulcanized rubber bottom cover. The belting is built for heavy-duty use in conveyor systems that move bulk materials such as coal, iron ore, minerals, and aggregates. It is provided in roll form with available widths from 500 mm to 2800 mm and thicknesses from 10 mm to 50 mm.
